description: Truncates a number to an integer by removing the decimal, or fractional, part of the number.

params.description: The number which will be truncated.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A number specifying the precision of the truncation. If this argument is omitted, it is equal to 0 (zero).
params.name: arg2

signature: TRUNC(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
